metadata.description: JimalH's shared Claude Code mods, installable on any machine.

plugins.name: jimal-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt that fits the space left and leaves 30 s after it finishes, plus a live agents panel (/agents-info). Fork of savvy-progress.

plugins.name: jimal-session
plugins.description: Mod: band above the prompt with the prompt cache countdown, session and weekly usage left, a keep-warm switch and auto-handoff with a handover note.
